purpose: Compare fresh shared SAC and PPO at the same live-experience budget with identical world, observations and physical action support.
primary_contrast: For every physical metric, compare (SAC trained minus its own initial) with (PPO trained minus its own initial).
initial_control: Both actors have zero deterministic actions, the same pre-transform Gaussian std and identical physical action mapping. Their deterministic initial metrics must match on all paired worlds; network tensors and initial critics are not matched.
checkpoint_selection: First saved checkpoint at or above 50k within one collection chunk; final at or above 100k. Record exact live experience and all optimizer counts. Do not select the best checkpoint.
resource_policy: One simulator worker; sequential algorithms. Two existing PPO coordinators remain unchanged; combined local simulator use stays below five workers.
failure_behavior: Stop this coordinator on technical failure, incomplete budget or identity mismatch. Retain all outputs and never auto-restart a failed run.
limitations: One exploratory training seed and twenty repeatedly used development worlds; no unseen-scenario or across-seed claim.
PPO uses clipped Gaussian sampling and one value critic; SAC uses tanh-squashed Gaussian sampling and two action-value critics.
PPO and SAC differ in critic capacity, initialization, minibatches, replay reuse and optimizer budgets. This compares registered algorithm recipes, not a single isolated mechanism.
SAC entropy temperature is learned from .01; PPO entropy weight stays .01. Their entropy objectives are not equivalent.
SAC warmup is 5000 counted slots; actual live count before optimization is recorded. One gradient round per vector decision depends on worker count.
Equal seed values do not couple stochastic actions. Identical zero-action initial physical behavior is verified separately.
100k live transitions is a screening budget, not a convergence claim. Failing the screen does not rule out either algorithm at a larger budget.
Fixed route guidance and static-area filtering provide support; aircraft conflict filtering remains off.
Use reserved streams 20301/20302 only after candidate selection. Official stream 42 remains untouched.
